_meta.description: Create a song in Suno (Advanced/Custom mode) from a title, style, and lyrics, then submit generation.

title.description: Song title. A double quote or backslash in it breaks the s1e and s9 selectors.

style.description: Style/genre prompt, e.g. 'dark synthwave, female vocals'

_meta.risk: CONSUMES CREDITS — the 'Create song' click (s8) generates two takes in the active workspace. To fill the form without generating, remove s8, s8b and s9. s1a and s8b raise the Suno tab and focus Chrome's window, because Chrome does not render the clip list in a hidden tab.

selectorNotes.lyrics: div[aria-label='Lyrics editor'] — contenteditable editor. Suno replaced the old <textarea data-testid='lyrics-textarea'> with a rich contenteditable div in the 2026-07 redesign. The relay's trustedType() detects contenteditable and uses CDP Input.insertText, so the 'type' action fills it correctly.
selectorNotes.style: [data-testid='create-form-styles-wrapper'] textarea — the style field is a <textarea> with a rotating genre placeholder and NO stable attribute of its own, but its section wrapper carries a stable data-testid. There are now 4 textareas in the form DOM (cowriter/style/simple-prompt/sounds), so the old positional 'first non-lyrics textarea' selector is ambiguous — scope by the styles wrapper.
selectorNotes.title: input[placeholder='Song Title (Optional)'] — stable placeholder. Two mirrored inputs exist (responsive layouts); both bind the same state, first-match is correct.
selectorNotes.create: button[aria-label='Create song'] — disabled until fields have content
selectorNotes.clipRow: [data-testid='clip-row'] — one row per take in the workspace clip list. The row's own attributes carry the take's title (aria-label) and its generation state (data-clip-status: submitted, queued, processing or streaming while it generates; complete or error when it is done). Suno sets both from the clip object, so both are present in every state. The title link a[href^='/song/'] is not: while a take is freshly generating, Suno draws a skeleton in .clip-title-wrapper instead of the title and the link. Checked in Suno's client bundle and in the live DOM on 2026-09-15. In a hidden tab the list does not render at all.

_meta.verified: 2026-07-08 — re-verified live against Suno's redesigned /create form (account: wolfreporter Pro). Lyrics field migrated textarea -> contenteditable div; style selector re-anchored to create-form-styles-wrapper. Fill path confirmed live; s8 generation confirmed live (rendered 'Everysing Vill Be Fine'). 2026-09-15 — proof rebuilt (s1a, s1d, s1e, s8b, s9); live check pending.

chain.note: Raise the tab and focus Chrome's window. Chrome does not render a hidden tab: on 2026-09-15 the clip list stayed empty for 60 s in a background tab and filled within 2 s of the tab being raised. s1e and s9 read that list.
dismiss promo modals (2026-09-12: a 'v6 — Promo Extended' dialog covered the form and hid the tabs from click_text)
navigate returns before the create form hydrates; clicking the tab too early fails with Not found (seen twice 2026-09-12)
Settle: give the clip list time to render before s1e reads it. It is soft because an empty workspace has no rows.

GUARD: stop before Create if an earlier take with this title is still generating. s9 cannot tell such a take from a new one, so it would pass even if this run created nothing. Suno also drops a Create without an error while too many songs are generating. If this step fails, wait for those takes to finish, then run again.
ensure Advanced/Custom mode — anchored on role+aria-label, not visible text, so an overlay can't hide it
Styles field, scoped by stable wrapper testid
GENERATES — consumes credits. To fill only, remove s8, s8b and s9.
Raise the tab again in case focus moved during the fill. s9 reads the clip list, which Chrome renders only in a visible tab.

PROOF that this run created the song: a clip row whose aria-label is the title and whose data-clip-status is not complete or error, which means a take with this title is still generating. Older takes with the same title are complete, so they do not match, and s1e has already stopped the run if an earlier run's take was still generating. The title text and the /song/<id> link are not used, because Suno shows a skeleton in their place while a take is freshly generating. History: the first s9 (added 2026-09-12, after four runs clicked Create 'ok' while Suno made nothing) waited for the title text. It timed out on real creates on 2026-09-12 (Nemo, I'm Not Dead Yet) and 2026-09-14 (I Choose You) for three reasons: the skeleton; the clip list does not render in a hidden tab (s1a and s8b now raise the tab); and the live wait_for did not interpolate {{title}} for runs sent through yeshie_run or POST /run (runtime fixed 2026-09-15). The feed API is NOT a reliable fallback: GET studio-api.prod.suno.com/api/feed/v2 page 0 left out both 'I Choose You' takes while they were generating. To check by hand, GET studio-api.prod.suno.com/api/feed/?ids=<id1>,<id2> with the Bearer token from `await window.Clerk.session.getToken()` in a suno.com tab; that call returned the generating clips, but it needs the clip ids.
